Name: Em's SVE Animals (collection bundle)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new design and four colour options for each [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] animal. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
It includes the animals, their produce and Marnie's livestock shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures

﻿This is a bundle of Em's SVE animals and items
If you only want one animal, have a look at the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36100]bears[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36534]geese[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36181]camels[/url] pages

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FHdvysyP/Camel_Items.png[/img]

The items included for the camels are their wool and yarn
There are four camel types (dromedary, bactrian, mogolian, wild)
The choice you make also affects their wool and yarn

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/CL6Ynf8y/Honey_Jar.png[/img]

The be﻿ar leaves honey jars around the barn
There is an option for a glass jar or a wooden pot

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's SVE Animals CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

To choose a different type of animal or item:
Open ﻿the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Em's mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]Name[/color]" with the name of the type you like
You can find all the options in the Reference.png in the mod folder
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's SVE Animals AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the scissors selected, left-click the animal and choose its type
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]
